Class ProcedureConfigSet

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model.ProcedureConfigSet

  • @Entity
public class ProcedureConfigSet
extends Object
    Configuration entity class representing the ProcedureConfigSet table. This is a join table for many of the configuration tables, and this class contains references to each of the entities.
